discription: A basic subtractive synthesizer using a Saw wave, a resonant low-pass filter, and an ADSR amplitude envelope. The filter cutoff can also be modulated by a separate envelope.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, rq=0.5, cutoff=4000, cutoffModAmt=0.5, atk=0.01, dec=0.1, sus=0.8, rel=1.0; var sig, ampEnv, filterEnv; ampEnv = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(atk, dec, sus, rel, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2); filterEnv = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.01, 0.2, 0.5, 0.5, curve: -4), gate: gate); var filterFreq = cutoff * (1 + (filterEnv * cutoffModAmt)); sig = Saw.ar(freq); sig = RLPF.ar(sig, filterFreq.max(200), rq); sig = sig * amp * ampEnv; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
